title: Weave feature glyphs
context: Weave is a web app where people and AI agents organize related records in workspaces. Each glyph sits beside a text label in the sidebar and in menus at 16 to 24 px, in light and dark themes, next to Lucide icons (24 px grid, 2 px stroke, round caps).

pairs.subject: Workspace
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Workspace: the top-level container for one domain of life or work. It holds spaces, and you switch between workspaces on a rail.

a.intent: A window frame with a narrow left rail of three dots beside a main pane, depicting the workspace switcher rail next to the content area.

b.intent: A briefcase, the literal container for one domain of work, with its handle and a horizontal band that reads as a container people switch between.

pairs.subject: Relation
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Relation: a field that links a record to records in another table.

a.intent: Two record cards joined by a bent connector line, the literal picture of one record linking to a record in another table.

b.intent: Two interlocked chain links, the universal symbol for a connection between one record and another.

pairs.subject: Rollup
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Rollup: a field that aggregates values across related records, such as a sum or a count.

a.intent: Three record rows on the left converge through a rounded bracket into a single circle on the right, showing many related values collapsing into one aggregated value.

b.intent: Four stacked row lines on the left funnel through two chevrons into a single bar on the right, showing many related values collapsing into one aggregate.

pairs.subject: Workflow
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Workflow: an automation: a trigger followed by steps that act on records.

a.intent: A trigger node at top left connected by an elbow line to a step node at bottom right, a minimal flow diagram of trigger then action.

b.intent: A round trigger node at top left connects by an elbow line down to a square step node, the flowchart convention for a trigger followed by an action.

pairs.subject: Record
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Record: a single item in a table, opened as a detail card that lists its fields.

a.intent: A portrait card with three rows, each a bullet dot and a value line, reading as a detail card listing a record’s fields.

b.intent: A rounded card with three rows, each a short label stub beside a longer value line, which reads as a record opened as a detail card listing its fields.

pairs.subject: Formula
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Formula: a computed field whose value is calculated from other fields.

a.intent: A sigma (summation) sign, the standard symbol for a calculated value, which reads as a field computed from other fields.

b.intent: The sigma summation glyph, the symbol of calculation, standing for a computed field.

pairs.subject: Space
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Space: a grouping inside a workspace that holds related tables and documents.

a.intent: A folder outline, the familiar container that holds related items, so it reads as a grouping of tables and documents.

b.intent: A folder outline, the familiar container for related items, reading as a grouping inside a workspace.

pairs.subject: Board view
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Board view: a view that shows records as cards in columns, one column per state.

a.intent: A framed panel holding three vertical bars of different heights, standing in for card stacks in three columns of a kanban board.

b.intent: Three side-by-side columns of different heights, the shape of a kanban board with one column per state.

pairs.subject: MCP agent access
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for MCP agent access: AI agents reading and writing the workspace through the MCP interface.

a.intent: A central node with six short spokes radiating to the edges, depicting many agents reaching into one shared workspace to read and write it.

b.intent: A robot head with an antenna, side ears and two eyes, representing the AI agents that connect to the workspace.

pairs.subject: Command-K search
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Command-K search: the search palette that jumps to any record in the workspace as you type.

a.intent: A magnifying glass, the universal search symbol, representing the type-to-jump search palette.

b.intent: Two nodes joined by a straight diagonal line, with short dashes trailing behind each end, depicting a jump from where you are to any record in one move.

pairs.subject: Document
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Document: a rich-text page attached to a record or a space.

a.intent: A page with a folded top-right corner and text lines, the standard rich-text document.

b.intent: A folded-corner page outline with a short last line and one blue text line, the standard document glyph, with the blue line marking the written rich-text content that makes it a document.

pairs.subject: Table
pairs.objective: Draw the glyph for Table: a set of records of one kind with typed fields, shown as rows and columns.

a.intent: A solid rounded block with a header row and a two-column grid of body rows cut out as negative space, which reads as a table of records with fields in rows and columns.

b.intent: A rounded grid with a header row, a second row line and a column divider, the standard rows-and-columns table.
